assertions.name: uses-react-hook-form
assertions.description: Uses react-hook-form instead of individual useState per field

assertions.name: has-zod-validation
assertions.description: Uses Zod with email and min 6 char password rules

assertions.name: shows-field-errors
assertions.description: Displays inline error messages below invalid fields

assertions.name: uses-pressable-scale
assertions.description: Submit button uses PressableScale for touch feedback

assertions.name: uses-token-spacing
assertions.description: Uses consistent spacing (no random numbers like 13 or 17)

prompt: Create a login screen for a healthcare app. Email and password fields, validation, submit button, loading state. Use React Hook Form + Zod. Make it not look like AI slop.
